purpose: Diagnose the remaining real Safari canvas OCR boundary without weakening P3A exact-text matching. Prove the loopback page is actually requested, establish the semantic NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET gap before visual resolution, and record only aggregate OCR diagnostics sufficient to distinguish raw exact matching from normalized/case representation mismatch.
requiredClaims: If Safari is already running, execution blocks before immutable evidence is created.
The existing real Safari application Provider and real Safari process/bundle are used.
The loopback server confirms Safari actually requests the test-owned page before OCR diagnostics are evaluated.
A fresh Safari semantic snapshot is evaluated before visual resolution and yields structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET for the canvas-only target.
The real product local macOS Vision text-region provider is used unchanged.
P3A remains raw exact-text-single-match and no fuzzy or normalized product matching is introduced in s05.

If raw exact resolution fails, evidence may contain only aggregate diagnostics: observation count, normalized exact count and minimum normalized edit distance; no OCR strings or coordinates are printed.
If exactly one normalized equivalent exists while raw exact matching fails, the session fails explicitly with SAFARI_CANVAS_EXACT_NORMALIZATION_MISMATCH rather than bypassing P3A.
No click is performed unless the existing P3A exact resolver succeeds.
If exact resolution succeeds, CLICK_POSTED remains delivery only and VERIFIED_SUCCESS still requires the independent FINISHED post-observation.
No built-in Safari visual-fallback contract is created or enabled.
Pointer, Safari, loopback server, runtime/cache and temporary resources are cleaned up and product trees remain clean.
nonClaims: P6B s05 does not change or validate normalized matching as product policy.
P6B s05 does not log raw OCR payloads to discover the mismatch.
P6B s05 does not validate generic Safari or arbitrary web automation.
P6B s05 does not ship a Safari caller contract or alter P1-P5/P6A/Computer Control contracts.

s01.reason: PoC oracle confused processed-unresolved with target presence.

s02.reason: Correct oracle; synthetic multi-token target had no raw exact Vision match.

s03.reason: 49 Vision observations but no raw exact match for OCR-hardened multi-token target.

s04.reason: 49 Vision observations but still no raw exact match for single-word uppercase PROCEED.

evidencePolicy.safariUserState: Preflight blocks before session creation if Safari is running; the physical test repeats the guard for races.
evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s05 unchanged. Use aggregate diagnostics to decide whether a narrowly justified product normalization contract is needed or whether the Safari canvas candidate should be rejected without weakening P3A.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned canvas content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR strings and coordinates remain ephemeral and out of session evidence.

onNormalizationMismatch.nextCheckpoint: Evaluate an explicit text-normalization contract separately; do not silently broaden P3A
